title: International Bartenders Association: official cocktails
notable_for: The IBA official cocktail list, the trade's standard specs

name: Kevin Williamson
known_for: Ranch Water on the Ranch 616 menu since 1998 (per Difford's)

name: Margarita (IBA)
steps: Shake everything hard with ice.
Strain into a chilled cocktail glass, half-salted rim if wanted.
glass: cocktail glass, optional half salt rim
notes: IBA spec as quoted in search excerpt; ratio roughly 10:4:3.

name: Margarita on the rocks (Difford's recipe)

lines.ingredient: saline solution (20 g sea salt : 80 g water)
lines.note: or a tiny pinch of salt

steps: Chill a rocks glass; salt the rim if wanted.
Shake all with ice.
Strain onto fresh ice; lime wedge.
glass: old fashioned / rocks, optional salt rim

name: Cadillac Margarita
steps: Chill a coupe; half salt rim optional.
Shake with ice.
Fine strain into the coupe; lime wedge.
notes: Difford's credits the El Torito Grill chain (Southern California) with popularising it in the 1980s. price_tier left null: the spec names brands, not a grade.

name: Frozen Margarita

lines.note: small amount, optional; added while blending

steps: Blend the liquids slowly without ice.
Add the xanthan gum gradually while blending.
Add the crushed ice and blend until smooth; pour into a chilled glass.

variants.name: Frozen Margarita WP (Difford's)
variants.change: 45 ml tequila, 22.5 ml Cointreau, 30 ml lime, 15 ml 2:1 syrup

name: Strawberry Margarita (frozen)

lines.ingredient: fresh strawberries, hulled, small and ripe

steps: Blend the first five ingredients without ice on slow.
Add xanthan gum gradually.
Add crushed ice, blend again, pour into a chilled coupe.
garnish: strawberry with a mint tip on the rim

name: Mango Margarita (frozen)
steps: Blend everything with the crushed ice until smooth.
Pour into a coupe; mango slice.

name: Spicy Margarita

lines.note: or a pinch of salt, optional

steps: Rim a rocks glass with Tajín (moisten the outside edge first).
Muddle chili and cilantro in the shaker.
Add the rest, shake with ice, fine strain onto fresh ice; lime wedge.
notes: Excerpt described this as Difford's main Spicy Margarita; the record ID (27664) could not be confirmed as the house spec rather than a community entry. See also Difford's spicy margaritas guide https://www.diffordsguide.com/g/1138/margarita-cocktail/spicy-margaritas

name: Mezcal Margarita
steps: Shake everything with ice.
Fine strain onto fresh ice; lime wedge.

variants.name: Tommy's Mezcal Margarita (Difford's)
variants.change: 2 oz mezcal, 1 oz lime, 1/2 oz agave syrup, 4 drops Margarita bitters; no orange liqueur

name: Skinny Margarita (Cookie and Kate)
steps: Salt the rim if wanted.
Shake tequila, citrus and agave hard with ice.
Strain over fresh ice; lime round.

variants.name: Pitcher for 10 (Cookie and Kate)
variants.change: 2 1/2 cups silver tequila, generous 1 3/4 cups lime juice, 1 1/4 cups orange juice, 3 tbsp + 1 tsp agave

notes: Orange juice replaces orange liqueur; home-cook source (tier 4).

name: Margaritas by the Gallon (Morgenthaler)
steps: Pour everything into a gallon jug, shake to mix, refrigerate.
To serve, salt the outside rim of a glass and pour over ice.
notes: Yield about 20 drinks per gallon. A second excerpt quoted different gallon proportions (6 tequila, 2.5 Cointreau, 5 lemon/lime, 2 simple), apparently from reader discussion; the figures above are those attributed to the post itself. No pre-dilution water in the batch: it is poured over ice.

name: Margarita (Jeffrey Morgenthaler)
steps: Shake with ice.
Strain into a salt-rimmed glass.
notes: Glass, ice and garnish not shown in the excerpt.

name: Frozen Daiquiri (Difford's)
steps: Blend the liquids with the crushed ice.
Pour into a chilled glass; lime wedge and cherry on the rim; straw.
garnish: lime wedge skewered with a maraschino cherry
notes: Page slug refers to a 16:6:6:1 formula. Difford's traces the blended daiquiri to Cuba (Emilio Gonzalez at the Plaza Hotel; made famous by Constante Ribalaigua at El Floridita).

name: Strawberry Daiquiri (frozen)

lines.ingredient: light gold rum (1-3 year molasses column)
fresh strawberries, hulled, small and ripe

steps: Blend the first four without ice to break down the berries.
Slow the blender and add xanthan gum.
Add crushed ice, blend slow-medium, pour into a chilled coupe.

name: Big-Batch Old Fashioned (Serious Eats)
steps: Combine in a bottle or pitcher and chill.
Pour over ice to serve.
notes: Serves 12. Already noted as a one-line variant on rx_old_fashioned_whiskey; recorded here as its own version per the versions rule. Excerpt came via a Punchfork mirror of the Serious Eats recipe.

name: Old Fashioned (muddled fruit version)
steps: Muddle orange and cherries in the shaker.
Add the rest, shake with ice.
Fine strain onto fresh ice (removes peel and skins).
garnish: orange zest twist and Luxardo cherry
notes: Difford's notes this style is often built in the serving glass; they shake and fine strain instead. Wisconsin brandy version exists separately (rx_brandy_old_fashioned_wisconsin).

name: Dirty Martini
steps: Stir everything with ice.
Strain into a chilled martini glass; skewered green olives.

variants.name: Filthy Dirty Martini (Difford's)
variants.change: more olive brine; separate Difford's entry, spec not captured

notes: Difford's own preference is 10-15 ml brine, up to 20 ml if the brine is mild; oil-packed olives emulsify badly.

name: Wet Martini (2:1)
steps: Stir with ice.
Fine strain into a chilled martini glass; olive or lemon twist.
garnish: green olive on a stick or lemon zest twist

variants.name: Sopping Wet (2:1.5, Difford's)
variants.change: raises vermouth to 1.5 parts per 2 of gin

notes: Difford's lists about 26% ABV and 167 kcal per serve.

name: Reverse Martini
steps: Stir with ice.
Fine strain into a chilled martini glass; olive or lemon twist.
garnish: chilled green olive or lemon zest twist

name: Vodka Martini (Vodkatini)
steps: Stir (or shake) with ice.
Strain into a chilled martini glass; express lemon twist and/or add an olive.
garnish: lemon zest twist and/or green olive

variants.name: Shaken (Difford's)
variants.change: if shaking use 10:1: 75 ml vodka, 7.5 ml dry vermouth; lemon twist

name: Mojito (IBA / Cuban build)
steps: Press mint gently with the sugar and lime in the glass.
Add rum and ice, top with soda, stir briefly.
notes: IBA spec as relayed by Wikipedia. La Bodeguita del Medio (Havana) is the reference Cuban bar; search results also cited Havana Club 3 Años as the typical rum. The modern reference build is rx_mojito.

name: Mojito Pitcher (A Couple Cooks)
steps: Make a mint simple syrup from the sugar, water and mint.
Combine syrup, lime and rum in a pitcher; can be chilled up to 2 hours ahead.
Add soda and ice only at service.

name: Strawberry & Balsamic Mojito
steps: Muddle strawberries in the glass.
Add mint, rum, lime, balsamic and syrup; two-thirds fill with crushed ice and churn.
Cap with more crushed ice, splash of soda, brief stir.
notes: Adapted by Difford's from a 2005 drink by Simon 'Ginge' Warneford.

name: Moscow Mule (IBA)
steps: Build over ice in a copper mug.
Top with ginger beer, stir gently; lime slice or wedge.
notes: IBA proportions as relayed by Wikipedia; existing reference rx_moscow_mule has no numbers.

name: Mexican Mule
steps: Stir tequila, lime and syrup in the mug.
Two-thirds fill with cubed ice, top with ginger beer, stir.
Crown with crushed ice; lime and mint; straw.

name: Kentucky Mule (Bourbon Mule)
steps: Chill the mug, two-thirds fill with cubed ice.
Add bourbon, lime and syrup, top with ginger beer.
Crown with crushed ice; lime slice and mint.

variants.name: Kentucky Mule (Difford's community entry)
variants.change: 60 ml bourbon, 30 ml lime, 20 ml cane syrup, 160 ml ginger beer; unverified community recipe

name: Espresso Martini (Difford's modern)
steps: Shake very hard with ice to build the foam.
Strain into a chilled glass; three coffee beans, optional lemon twist.
garnish: 3 coffee beans, optional lemon zest twist

variants.name: Simple 3 equal parts (Difford's)
variants.change: equal parts vodka, espresso and coffee liqueur; amounts not captured

notes: Difford's spec as relayed by The Three Drinkers. The Bradsell original is the existing reference rx_espresso_martini.

name: Jalisco Espresso (tequila Espresso Martini)
steps: Shake with ice.
Fine strain into a chilled coupe.

variants.name: Espresso Margarita (Difford's)
variants.change: 2 oz reposado tequila, 1 oz espresso, 1/4 oz lime, 1/3 oz agave syrup; no coffee liqueur

name: Piña Colada (shaken)

lines.ingredient: cream of coconut (Coco López or similar)

steps: Shake hard with ice.
Strain into a hurricane glass over fresh ice.
notes: Difford's community recipe (Patrick Brady), not tested by Difford's, hence low. Ice and garnish not shown. The blended reference is rx_pina_colada.

name: Bloody Mary
steps: Stir gently with ice in a mixing glass.
Pour into a rocks glass, or a highball with ice if asked; celery and lemon wedge optional.
notes: Wikipedia and Difford's credit Fernand Petiot; creation date disputed so year left null.

name: Bloody Mary (Difford's)
steps: Salt-rim the glass.
Roll everything between two tins with ice.
Strain onto fresh ice; celery plus a skewer of cherry tomato, gherkin and cocktail onion.
garnish: celery stalk; skewered cherry tomato, gherkin, cocktail onion

name: Bloody Maria
steps: Roll all ingredients with ice.
Strain into an ice-filled glass.

variants.name: Liquor.com Bloody Maria
variants.change: 4 oz fresh tomato juice and 1/2 oz lemon juice with Worcestershire, Tabasco, Tapatío, horseradish, celery salt and pepper (tequila amount not captured)

notes: Only tequila and tomato quantities were visible in the excerpt. Liquor.com page URL not captured.

name: Long Island Iced Tea
steps: Add everything but the cola to an ice-filled highball.
Top with cola and stir gently; lemon slice.
notes: IBA spec as relayed by Wikipedia (tier 3). Garnish per common IBA listing not confirmed in excerpt beyond lemon.

name: Long Island Iced Tea (Difford's)
steps: Build over ice, top with cola, stir.

variants.name: The Real Long Island Ice Tea (Difford's community)
variants.change: 15 ml each of five spirits with 30 ml sweet-and-sour mix and 30 ml cola (sour-mix bar style); attribution in excerpt uncertain

notes: ml values computed at 30 ml/oz (12.6); Difford's metric is likely 12.5 ml.

name: Lemon Drop
steps: Sugar the rim of a chilled cocktail glass.
Shake with ice and strain in.

name: Lemon Drop Martini (Difford's)
steps: Shake with ice.
Fine strain into a chilled martini glass; express a lemon twist.

name: Ranch Water

lines.note: or soda with a few drops of saline

steps: Build tequila, lime, triple sec and agave over ice.
Top with mineral water, stir briefly.

variants.name: Three-ingredient Texas build
variants.change: tequila, lime and Topo Chico only, no liqueur or syrup (amounts vary)

notes: Difford's credits Kevin Williamson, on the Ranch 616 menu since 1998. Glass and garnish not shown in excerpt.

name: Michelada (Rick Bayless)

lines.note: half used to wet the rim; juice added to glass; amount not shown

steps: Rub a cut lime around the rim of a 16 oz mug, dip in salt or Tajín.
Half fill with ice, add lime juice and beer.
Add hot sauce, Worcestershire and/or Maggi if wanted; stir just to combine.
glass: 16 oz beer mug, salt or Tajín rim
notes: Bayless treats the lime-and-salt beer as the original and the sauces as the common add-ons. No numeric spec found in tier 1-2 sources.

name: Mimosa
steps: Chill both well.
Pour into a flute, no ice; orange twist.

variants.name: Grand Mimosa (Difford's)
variants.change: adds Grand Marnier to the orange juice and sparkling wine; amounts not captured

notes: IBA 1:1 spec as relayed by Wikipedia.
